scripts.title: Snowy Hub | Auto Job, Fling, Kill Aura, Car speed & More
scripts.features:
Fly (WASD + Space/Ctrl): Smooth directional flight with full keyboard controls.
Fly Speed: Adjust your flight speed with a customizable slider.
NoClip: Walk through walls, doors, and other obstacles.
Infinite Jump: Jump endlessly without touching the ground.
Walk Speed: Customize your movement speed.
Lock Walk Speed: Constantly enforces your selected WalkSpeed.
Jump Power: Adjust how high your character jumps.
Fling Self (Mega Jump): Launch yourself across the map with powerful physics.
Fling Nearest Player: Attempts to fling the closest player away.
Fling ALL Players: Continuously targets every player with fling physics.
Spam Sit Nearest Player: Repeatedly forces sit interactions near the closest player.
Spectate Nearest Player: Instantly switch your camera to the nearest player.
Stop Spectate: Return your camera back to your character.
Invisible (Local): Makes your character locally invisible.
Restore Visibility: Restores your normal character appearance.
ForceField (Visible): Adds a visible forcefield effect to your character.
Fullbright: Removes darkness for maximum visibility.
No Fog: Eliminates map fog for clearer vision.
FOV Changer: Freely adjust your camera field of view.
Third Person Zoom Out: Increase the maximum camera zoom distance.
Rainbow Character: Cycles your character through rainbow colors.
Neon Glow Character: Applies a bright neon material effect.
Big Head Mode: Enlarges your character's head for fun.
Delete Nearest Part: Removes the nearest interactable part locally.
Teleport Into Nearest House: Instantly teleport inside the closest house.
Copy Nearest Player: Copies the appearance of the nearest player.
Auto Collect Money/Items: Automatically collects nearby cash and pickups.
Auto Job (Cycle Jobs): Automatically cycles through available jobs.
Fire All Economy Remotes: Executes detected economy-related remotes.
Print All Remotes: Logs discovered remote events/functions for debugging.
Rejoin: Quickly reconnect to your current server.
Server Hop: Instantly join a different public server.
Copy My Position: Copies your current coordinates to the clipboard.
Anti-AFK: Prevents idle kicks while you're away.
Bring All Players to Me: Attempts to bring nearby players to your position.
Freelook (Unlock Camera): Unlock your camera for independent viewing.
Fly (Enhanced): Premium flight with improved responsiveness.
Fly Speed: Adjustable premium flight speed.
Kill Aura (Fling Ring): Automatically flings nearby players within range.
Teleport Into Nearest House: One-click house teleport.
Auto Collect Money/Items: Automatically farms nearby pickups.
Server Hop: Quickly switch to another server.
Bring All Players to Me: Premium player bring utility.
Freelook (Unlock Camera): Free camera movement without character rotation.

scripts.title: Sp3arParvus
scripts.features:
CapsLock — Minimize or restore the main menu window

Ctrl + ` — Toggle Camera Tracking Assistant (AimLock)
Ctrl + Q — QTeleport: teleport character to mouse cursor position
Ctrl + E — Execute Any-Item-ESP
Ctrl + R — Rejoin current server
Ctrl + Shift + R — Force reload script from GitHub
Ctrl + Y — Teleport to most recently created waypoint
Ctrl + U — Unload script
Ctrl + P — Toggle Freecam mode
Ctrl + F — Toggle Fullbright
Ctrl + N — Toggle FullDark
Ctrl + G — Toggle Ghost Mode
Ctrl + H — Toggle Head-Only targeting mode
Ctrl + J — Toggle Item Panel
Ctrl + K — Open menu and navigate to PlayerPage tab
Ctrl + B — Toggle Br3ak3r mode
Ctrl + Z — Undo last Br3ak3r break
Ctrl + Shift + Z — Undo last H1ghl1ght3r highlight
Ctrl + X — Clear all Br3ak3r breaks
Ctrl + Shift + X — Clear all H1ghl1ght3r highlights
Ctrl + . — Toggle Information Display overlay
Ctrl + Up Arrow — Force character position upward
Ctrl + Down Arrow — Force character position downward
Ctrl + Left Arrow — Force character position left
Ctrl + Right Arrow — Force character position right
Ctrl + Shift + Up Arrow — Force character position forward
Ctrl + Shift + Down Arrow — Force character position backward

Right Mouse Button (Hold) — Activate Camera Tracking (when Always Active is OFF)
Ctrl + Left Click — Break part collision under cursor (Br3ak3r)
Ctrl + Shift + Left Click — Highlight part under cursor (H1ghl1ght3r)
Ctrl + Middle Click — Place waypoint at cursor position (or delete nearby waypoint)
Ctrl + Shift + Middle Click — Destroy all active waypoints
Ctrl + Shift + Scroll Up — Undo last Br3ak3r break
Ctrl + Shift + Scroll Down — Break part under cursor
Ctrl (Hold) — Expand scroll unlocker camera zoom range


Freecam Controls (active while Freecam is ON)

W / A / S / D — Move camera
E — Move camera up
Q — Move camera down
U / H / J / K — Move character while in freecam
Space — Make character jump
I — Toggle character ragdoll (PlatformStand)
Y — Respawn character
Up Arrow — Increase freecam speed
Down Arrow — Decrease freecam speed
Left Shift — Slow movement (0.30x multiplier)
Mouse Wheel — Adjust camera FOV
Left Alt — Toggle mouse lock
T — Teleport character to camera position and exit freecam
